terrainDescription.zh: 廣大平原與黑土農業帶，是歐洲重要糧倉地區
terrainDescription.en: Vast plains with fertile black soil — one of Europe's major agricultural breadbaskets

plate.color: white background, black text; blue vertical band on the left with Ukrainian flag colors + "UA" code (since 2015); only Cyrillic glyphs resembling Latin letters are used

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Wide red rectangular reflector (wider than Hungary/Bulgaria/Croatia/North Macedonia's), commonly visibly worn or damaged

utilityPole.transformerMount: Many poles have a white-painted base section; otherwise a standard grey concrete shaft

historicalContext.zh: 與俄語同屬東斯拉夫分支，拼字與部分詞彙相近但非相同語言，需搭配路牌拼字細節區分。
historicalContext.en: Shares the East Slavic branch with Russian, with similar but distinct spelling and vocabulary — distinguish via detailed sign spelling.
